description: This file is a shell script named 'generate_rag_report.sh'. It generates a RAG (Red, Amber, Green) status report for HAL interface components by parsing metadata YAML files across projects, creating a markdown report structured with various sections including component status and review progress.

methods.name: yaml_val
methods.description: Parses a top-level YAML key's value from a file.

methods.name: yaml_nested
methods.description: Parses nested YAML values, such as notes or lifecycle details.

methods.name: yaml_review_progress
methods.description: Calculates review progress (reviewed/total) from the reviewers section.

methods.name: yaml_reviewer_status
methods.description: Retrieves review status of a specific team from the reviewers section.

methods.name: review_icon
methods.description: Maps review status to visual indicators.

methods.name: component_path
methods.description: Determines the component's relative path based on the filename.

methods.name: rag_icon
methods.description: Maps status to RAG indicator symbols.
